aaa_enabled.summary: Configure centralized authentication (RADIUS, TACACS+, or LDAP/AD) in ACOS.
aaa_enabled.notes: Configure remote AAA servers under global configuration mode: aaa {authentication | authorization}.

secure_vty_transport.summary: Disable HTTP management and restrict SSH access.
secure_vty_transport.notes: Use the enable-management service commands to restrict management methods.

vty_idle_timeout.notes: Modify session timeout under global configuration in minutes.

enable_secret_encrypted.summary: Ensure administrative account passwords are encrypted.
enable_secret_encrypted.notes: ACOS local administrative passwords are automatically hashed in the system.

no_default_snmp_community.notes: Modify SNMP community settings under global configuration: snmp-server community.

ssh_version_2.notes: SSH configuration settings are managed via the ssh command suite under global configuration mode.

logging_enabled.notes: Configure a syslog host using the logging host command.

management_acl.summary: Restrict Web Management Console and SSH access to trusted IP hosts.
management_acl.notes: Restrict access by defining management ACL interface permissions using the enable-management command options.

login_banner.notes: Configure login warning banner in global configuration using banner login.

password_min_length.notes: Configure password complexity rules under global configuration settings.

no_write_snmp_community.notes: Ensure SNMP communities are restricted to read-only.
